# signing key

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:signingKey`](gmeow-signingKey.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/signingKey>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/trust`](../../slices/trust.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The cryptographic key that produced a signature (the trust module's [`CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md)). Complements [`gmeow:signedBy`](gmeow-signedBy.md): [`signedBy`](gmeow-signedBy.md) gives the identity, [`signingKey`](gmeow-signingKey.md) gives the key — the pair a [`gmeow:Certification`](../classes/gmeow-Certification.md) attests.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md) -> [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the cryptographic key that produced a signature — the WHICH-KEY half of the signing act, the key whose binding to the signer a certification vouches for.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the signer identity (that is [`gmeow:signedBy`](gmeow-signedBy.md)) and for an agent's general key possession ([`gmeow:holdsKey`](gmeow-holdsKey.md)); [`signingKey`](gmeow-signingKey.md) names the specific key used for THIS signature. It is functional — one signing key per signature.

### How to use

- Bind exactly one [`gmeow:CryptographicKey`](../classes/gmeow-CryptographicKey.md) and pair it with [`gmeow:signedBy`](gmeow-signedBy.md); verify the [`signedBy`](gmeow-signedBy.md)/signingKey pair against a [`gmeow:Certification`](../classes/gmeow-Certification.md) and record the outcome in [`gmeow:verificationStatus`](gmeow-verificationStatus.md).
